decision: Canonical names and categories override older implementation labels
rationale: The user-provided spec is the source of truth for the audit

decision: a-020 to a-032 use category revenue-operations and route vaayvu://revenue/a-NNN
rationale: Canonical Revenue operations inventory

decision: Reward balances derive from immutable ledger postings and failed fetches show unavailable

decision: Payout state accepts only verified provider callbacks and never regresses Paid to Pending
rationale: Signature verification dedupe and ordered transitions are required

decision: Ads consent and rewards enrollment stay independent
rationale: Declining ads must leave browsing and Rasha fully available

decision: Rejected creative cannot become deliverable through a status edit
rationale: Independent review and immutability are required

decision: s-582 to s-600 and s-601 to s-623 use canonical migration library search enterprise family support and quality screens

decision: P00 exit artifacts are drafted but not signed
rationale: Only a human owner can sign the charter and exit gate

decision: Node 22.13.0 is the pinned minimum toolchain and scripts/doctor.cjs enforces it
rationale: Reproducible setup needs one executable check

decision: P01 remains unverified until a remote CI run is observed locally green CI is not evidence of remote green
rationale: Evidence rules require observable evidence

decision: Three engine spikes were executed with recorded results
rationale: Spike evidence replaces the earlier missing-result state

decision: GeckoView is a conditional prototype go and a product no-go until blocker parity media DRM and packaging are measured
rationale: Runtime loading alone does not prove VFD parity

decision: Design tokens are canonical in design/tokens.json and guarded against chrome/styles.css
rationale: Token drift must fail CI design/tokens.json;

decision: P03 prototype tests are present but remain unverified until Playwright probes run locally or remotely
rationale: Existing probe files are not proof of execution

decision: P04 SQLite domain store is implemented as a tested reference layer and is not wired into the shipping renderer
rationale: Rewiring desktop persistence is a separate change with migration risk

decision: Recovered unclean sessions are marked so recovery is not repeated
rationale: A relaunch must not resurface the same crashed session repeatedly

decision: Signed 0.0.23 macOS artifacts exist but do not represent the current source
rationale: Signed stale artifacts cannot close the current phase gate

decision: P05 download lifecycle is implemented but lacks a native Electron assertion
rationale: Screen-level tests are not native file-download evidence

decision: iOS does not advertise canDefaultBrowser because the app cannot change the system default browser
rationale: Platform acceptance test expects the capability to be absent

decision: The existing iOS IPA is development-signed and is not evidence of a TestFlight build
rationale: TestFlight requires an App Store Connect upload and processing

decision: P03 interactive probes executed successfully after installing Chromium
rationale: Local execution is valid phase evidence for the prototype gate

decision: P04 gate is accepted at the contract level because the exit gate asks for state machines migrations and tested recovery
rationale: Shipping integration is tracked separately

decision: GeckoView 161 requires compileSdk 37 so the spike pins 145
rationale: The project builds against SDK 36 with AGP 9.1

decision: The Android product remains Java/WebView; GeckoView is a spike not the shipping engine
rationale: Migrating engines is a separate architecture program

decision: The Android release identity is now Vaayvu with dev.vaayvu.app and a new Vaayvu keystore
rationale: The owner requested removal of the legacy identity; upgrades from the old package require a fresh install

decision: Navigation URL validation rejects control characters backslashes and oversized URLs before parsing
rationale: Hostile inputs must not be normalized into an accepted navigation

decision: P08 local security gate is green but external hostile-site testing remains unverified
rationale: A third-party audit cannot be replaced by a local corpus

decision: Translation is offered only when a host advertises canTranslate and no shipping host does
rationale: The UI must not pretend to translate

decision: Content workflow E2E includes reader extraction PDF and PNG capture in the desktop suite
rationale: These are the content operations the app can prove end to end

decision: Sync payloads are server-readable and not end-to-end encrypted
rationale: The documented sync schema stores regular URLs and titles in SQLite

decision: Passkeys are delegated to platform WebAuthn rather than a custom vault
rationale: The browser does not implement its own credential store

decision: Session recipes are atlas screen contracts without a persistent shipping recipe engine
rationale: The workflow screens do not equal an automation runtime

decision: Split view is implemented and screen-tested but lacks a native pane resize probe
rationale: No fake E2E claim for split panes

decision: The shipping extension runtime is CSS-only and rejects scripts wildcards store packages and network-capable CSS
rationale: CSS-only is the security boundary

decision: Enterprise policy screens are contracts without MDM/GPO/plist enforcement
rationale: Screen coverage is not a managed-policy runtime

decision: AI page text is redacted client-side and wrapped as untrusted JSON server-side with no model tools
rationale: Prompt injection and secret leakage must be bounded at both layers

decision: The agent policy guard exists but no agent executor ships
rationale: Guarded screens are not a runtime

decision: Performance results are local and telemetry-free with a published JSON baseline
rationale: Reproducibility requires a stored baseline and comparator

decision: CPU time is an energy proxy and heap delta is not a peak or leak result
rationale: No joule or leak claim without a dedicated measurement

decision: RTL/CJK layout and formatting ship but no translated string catalog exists
rationale: English strings are not a localized release

decision: VoiceOver TalkBack and Narrator are not device-verified in this audit
rationale: Automated aria checks do not equal a screen-reader session

decision: Mac and Windows artifacts are signed and verified but Apple notarization was not performed
rationale: No notary credentials are available

decision: Rollback is verified as a dry run over both manifests without installing an old build
rationale: A live rollback needs a managed device

decision: P17 cannot be verified without real beta users and measured SLOs
rationale: No telemetry cohort exists and inventing numbers violates evidence rules

decision: P17 depends on P35 which has not been submitted
rationale: Release evidence is a declared dependency

decision: Critical-work leases expire between 30 seconds and 1 hour and protect tabs from idle sleep and pressure reclaim
rationale: A forgotten lease must not pin memory forever

decision: The lifecycle harness stubs renderer close and reports CPU time as an energy proxy
rationale: Renderer teardown cost needs a separate trace

decision: Storage writes return a quota failure and keep the previous value rather than throwing into the UI
rationale: Settings must survive a full disk

decision: Encrypted DNS is a screen contract and no DoH resolver ships
rationale: No DNS privacy claim without a resolver

decision: The VFD rule database is original hand-authored work with per-rule provenance and no third-party list files
rationale: Ownership must be auditable

decision: Private tabs ignore paused-site relaxations while first-party tokens still require aggressive mode
rationale: Privacy must not silently unblock trackers

decision: The secure vault is a tested AES-GCM reference module and is not wired into a shipping credential UI
rationale: Integration is a separate product change

decision: Hostile pages cannot access Node Electron or chrome-origin storage and permissions are denied
rationale: Isolation must be proven end to end

decision: Desktop containers remain screen contracts while private and Android profile partitions are real
rationale: No desktop container runtime exists

decision: Tab IDs must survive reload and restore and are asserted in the desktop probe
rationale: Stable identity is required for groups and leases

decision: P23 fault recovery backup and sentinel tests pass but sync payload is not end-to-end encrypted
rationale: TLS is not the same as E2E payload encryption

decision: A private sentinel must be absent from every SQLite file and snapshot
rationale: Sync must never persist private pages

decision: Research collections are a local-first tested module and are not wired to a shipping research screen
rationale: The reading list remains the shipping local workflow

decision: The focus timer stores an absolute deadline so reload cannot reset it
rationale: Decrementing timers drift and reset

decision: Automation requires explicit consent matching URL and named single-use approval before any handler runs
rationale: No unconsented context or destructive action

decision: Automation receipts must not contain page text or step detail
rationale: Receipts are not a context leak

decision: The shipping workflow screens have no automation executor
rationale: The contract layer is not a runtime

decision: PDF PNG and MHTML exports are native and leave the page URL and title unchanged
rationale: Save-copy must not mutate the page

decision: Download quarantine resume and integrity remain screen contracts
rationale: No native resume or checksum test exists

decision: P27 cannot be verified without real-device playback and call tests
rationale: No product WebRTC call path or media lab

decision: Style extensions are independent of Rasha and ad blocking and grant no script permission
rationale: No forbidden dependency either direction

decision: PWA install window and offline runtime remain screen contracts
rationale: No PWA capability is claimed

decision: The standards corpus is WPT-style and not an official WPT run
rationale: No official pass rate may be claimed

decision: The comparative lab is same-machine same-runtime and does not compare against other browsers
rationale: Cross-browser claims need a separate controlled study

decision: A case must stay at or below 10 percent coefficient of variation to pass stability
rationale: Noisy medians are not published as results

decision: Light and dark are the two shipped presets and high contrast is an extra accessibility mode
rationale: Preset count must be explicit

decision: iPad requires a popover source for UIActivityViewController presentation
rationale: Missing source crashes on iPad

decision: P32 cannot claim physical mobile parity without devices
rationale: Simulators and emulators are not physical evidence

decision: Bookmark import/export is bounded escaped and URL-validated and there is no public search index
rationale: Import/export must not create a leak or index

decision: Full account data export remains a screen contract
rationale: No account export runtime is claimed

decision: Managed policy is HMAC-signed scoped and fully disclosed and supervised exit requires guardian or PIN
rationale: Safe exit must not trap the owner

decision: MDM/GPO ingestion and key distribution remain unwired
rationale: The policy contract is not a managed deployment runtime

decision: P35 release decision is no-go while P17 P27 and P32 critical blockers remain
rationale: Signed artifacts do not equal release readiness

decision: A release gate must aggregate phase status and signed artifact hashes rather than a hand-written claim
rationale: Readiness must be reproducible

decision: Revenue inventory is owned-only with no third-party publisher inventory or resale
rationale: Advertiser terms must not imply inventory the product does not own

decision: P36 cannot be approved without product legal security privacy approvals and a jurisdiction decision
rationale: Contracts are not approvals

decision: Campaign creatives must be HMAC-signed and placed only on owned allowlisted inventory
rationale: Unsigned or swapped creative must never serve

decision: Ads and Rasha are independent switches and rewards consent is not ads consent
rationale: No coupling or implied consent

decision: Reward funding accepts collected net revenue only and every posting must balance
rationale: Uncollected invoiced revenue cannot fund rewards

decision: Payout keys and provider evidence are idempotent and provider approval gates all payouts
rationale: Duplicate submission cannot create a second payout

decision: Monetization rollout is 0 percent until approvals release reconciliation support and measured economics exist
rationale: Signed code is not a pilot

decision: No revenue impression or payout economics are published while unmeasured
rationale: Invented economics would violate evidence rules

decision: P00 charter signed by owner attestation on 2026-11-28 for product, engineering and evidence roles
rationale: The owner explicitly authorized the typed attestation
